info.name: arTaH
info.note: sidDAntakOmudyAm asya DAtoH arTaH 'pratiyatne' iti nirdiSya 'ayam arTAntare api, yaTA dravyam arjayati' iti udAharaRam uktam asti . 'pratiyatna' ityasya arTaH tu 'guRADAnam' (guRaprAptiH) iti gfhyate .

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to earn, to do business, to prepare

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: arjana karanA, udyoga karanA, tEyAra karanA

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: pratiyatnaH = guRADAnam - tattvaboDinI . ' ayamarTAntarepi . dravyamarjayati ' iti kOmudI . ' pratiyatnerjayedarjerarjatItyarjane padam ' (Slo. 63) iti devaH .

examples: 'yaTA sAvasAn (paSUn) kftvA prArjayet tAdfk tat' (jE0 brA0 1.38).

'taM tu vEvAhikaM dfzwvA kanyeyaM samupArjitam' (BA0 u0 176.50). samupArjitam=saMskftam. tam (vicitravIryam).
'svasti hEnamatyarjanti svargaM lokarmABa' (E0 brA0 1.11). atyarjanti gamayanti prApayanti. atiH sOzWava iti zaqguru0. atiSabdaH kziprArTa iti govindasvAmI.
